title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents
title_zh: FOCUS：面向 LLM Agents 的免训练决策保持型上下文压缩
abstract_en: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories. In this paper we ask a complementary question: Which past interactions causally shape the agent's future decisions? We recast context compression as a causal decision preservation problem over discrete interaction units and introduce FOCUS, a training-free context compression framework that operates entirely at test time. Our method requires no offline data collection or fine-tuning, and is architecture-agnostic, attaching to any closed-API frontier model as a modular compression layer. We evaluate FOCUS on diverse agentic benchmarks including API and tool-calling, QA, web domain and multi-turn dialogue. Our method establishes new state of the art performance, cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points over uncompressed execution.
abstract_zh: LLM Agents 的交互历史会随任务长度线性增长，导致推理成本呈二次扩展，并因注意力稀释造成性能下降。现有上下文压缩方法通常依赖离线训练，通过对比学习、压缩器蒸馏或压缩策略学习来决定丢弃内容，成本较高，且难以根据测试时不断演化的轨迹动态调整。本文将上下文压缩重新定义为离散交互单元上的因果决策保持问题，提出免训练的 FOCUS 框架，仅在测试时识别真正影响 Agent 后续决策的历史交互。FOCUS 无需离线数据收集或微调，与模型架构无关，可作为模块化压缩层接入任意闭源 API 前沿模型。在 API 与工具调用、问答、网页领域和多轮对话等多类 Agent 基准上，FOCUS 达到新的 state-of-the-art：最多减少 48% 的峰值上下文、降低 73% 的依赖量，并较未压缩执行将任务成功率提升最多 8.9 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 将上下文压缩形式化为因果决策保持问题，核心目标是保留会影响 Agent 后续行为的交互历史。
FOCUS 完全在测试时运行，无需离线数据、微调或压缩策略训练，并可兼容任意闭源 API 模型。
方法以离散交互单元为压缩对象，能够根据当前不断演化的任务轨迹动态决定保留与丢弃内容。
在 API 与工具调用、QA、网页和多轮对话基准上取得 state-of-the-art，峰值上下文最多减少 48%。
相较未压缩执行，FOCUS 最多降低 73% 的依赖量，并将任务成功率提升 8.9 个百分点。

llm_assessment.comment: FOCUS is a broadly deployable runtime context-management method that preserves agent decisions while reducing long-horizon inference costs.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: FOCUS 是一种可广泛部署的运行时上下文管理方法，能够在降低长程推理成本的同时保持智能体决策。
